title: R&M — Tasman District Council: additional real patrol zones found in the full 6,366-row raw log (Phase 2 import prep)
notes: Wave 1 seeded only 2 TDC zones (Rabbit Island, Appleby Recreation Reserve) from a small sample. Exporting the full 6,366-row DATA sheet plus the List reference sheet found 43 real CODE values in use. This wave adds the next 11 highest-value, confidently-geocoded ones (all verified live via linz-lookup address_autocomplete, cross-checked against the client's own List sheet Name->Code lookup).

Busch Reserve (Aniseed Valley Road) is confirmed via this List sheet + geocode to be a TDC reserve, NOT a Nelson City Council one - NCC's own log also mentions 'Busch Reserve' but that reference could not be confidently geocoded to anywhere in Nelson City and was deliberately left unmapped for NCC; this TDC zone is the real one.

Haldane Rd and Rototai Reserve share the same CODE (TAKA) in TDC's own DATA sheet for some rows despite being two distinct real places in the Takaka/Golden Bay area (confirmed via distinct comment content - Haldane Rd rows mention river/greenwaste dumping, Rototai Reserve rows mention walkers/dogs) - both zones are added here, but the code TAKA itself is deliberately NOT used as a zone-map key (it's ambiguous between the two); the importer resolves these via the Location text column instead.

IMPORTANT: matches EXISTING org 'Tasman District Council' (organization_id 54ade19f-0bb7-45ca-a32d-2d87214c4e77) via the seed script's parent_organization_id=R&M + lower(name) match - verified safe: a second, unrelated 'Tasman District Council' org exists in this project with parent_organization_id=null, but the script's WHERE parent_organization_id = provider clause cannot match it.

No 'agreement' key included deliberately - TDC's operational agreement already exists and is accepted from wave 1; new zones are linked to it via a direct SQL INSERT INTO service_agreement_locations after this seed applies, same pattern as NCC wave4/DOC wave3b.
